steps: Built Workspace.BastionSiege folder: neon BastionCore objective + SpawnRing of 8 concrete spawn pads in a 40-stud circle
Authored ServerScriptService.BastionSiegeLoop server script (config-driven wave table)
Each wave clones ServerStorage.EnemyTemplate onto ring pads facing the core, escalating count/health per wave
Wave clears when every spawned enemy's Humanoid.Died fires (player-dealt damage; NO auto-kill hook)
After the final wave clears it logs ALL WAVES CLEARED then VICTORY, all tagged [System]

recipe.text: Fresh 'BastionSiege' concept: enemies spawn from a ring and besiege a central Bastion Core. Config CONFIG.waves drives count+health per wave; spawnInterval/interWaveDelay/startDelay tune pacing. runWave counts alive enemies and only clears on real Humanoid.Died events, so progression to VICTORY requires actual player combat. All lifecycle events (ONLINE, SIEGE BEGIN, WAVE n START, SPAWN, WAVE n CLEARED, ALL WAVES CLEARED, VICTORY) print with the [System] tag for VERIFY to observe via playtest_logs.
